subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: Jobs in Airports and Aviation (Listening & Speaking)
lesson: Explanations practice, choosing a job, Listening 4.4.3 and a talk from a Fact File
outcomes: Explain what car parts are used for and rank factors in choosing a job
Listen to a pilot and identify the rewards of his job
Analyse an informative essay and use conjunctions for cohesion

tf.s: The bonnet protects the engine of a car.
tf.why: Yes, the bonnet covers and protects the engine.

tf.s: The headlight is used to signal which way the car is turning.
tf.why: The headlight lights the road; the indicator signals turns.

tf.s: Steve the pilot mentions good pay as a reward of his job.
tf.why: Correct, good pay is one of the rewards he ticks.

tf.s: Steve says job security is the main reward of being a pilot.
tf.why: Job security is one of the things Steve does not mention.

tf.s: For pilots, flexibility means they can have days on and off and group off days together.
tf.why: Right, that is how Steve explains flexibility.

tf.s: When you give a talk, you should keep eye contact and speak in complete sentences.
tf.why: Yes, these help your audience follow you.

tf.s: The Oman Rail essay has three paragraphs.
tf.why: It has five: an introduction, three main body paragraphs and a conclusion.

tf.s: The main body of the Oman Rail essay describes economic, social and environmental benefits.
tf.why: Correct, each body paragraph covers one kind of benefit.
However shows contrast; moreover and furthermore show addition.

tf.s: 'As a result' is a conjunction that shows a result.
tf.why: Yes, it links a cause to its effect.

boxes.why: Headlights help drivers see the road.

o: to signal which way the car is turning
boxes.why: Indicators tell others where you are going.

mcq.q: Which reward does Steve NOT mention?
mcq.why: Steve does not mention job security.

mcq.q: What are the three benefits in the main body of the Oman Rail essay?
mcq.why: Each body paragraph gives one of these benefits.

mcq.q: What are the parts of an informative essay?
mcq.why: An essay opens, develops ideas and closes.
But shows a different or opposite idea.

mcq.q: Your partner points to the number plate. What question do you ask?
o: What is the number plate used for?
Where is the number plate used for?
mcq.why: 'What is ... used for?' asks about the purpose of a part.

mcq.q: Choose the best conjunction: 'Trains are fast. ___, they are safe.'
mcq.why: Moreover adds a second positive idea.

mcq.q: Choose the best conjunction: 'Many people drive. ___, roads are crowded.'
mcq.why: Crowded roads are the result of many people driving.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a topic sentence?
o: The rail network will also bring many social benefits.
mcq.why: It gives the main idea of the paragraph.

mcq.q: Why should a speaker keep eye contact during a talk?
o: it keeps the audience interested and connected
mcq.why: Looking at listeners keeps them involved.

mcq.q: Why do groups need to compromise when ranking job factors?
o: people value different factors, so they must agree together
there is only one correct answer
mcq.why: Each person has different priorities, so they negotiate.
